## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A one-fascicle (1卷) **prolegomena** (*xuánshì* 懸示) prefacing [真鑑](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%9C%9F%E9%91%91)'s *Zhèngmài shū* ([KR6j0683](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0683)). The *xuánshì* ("hovering exposition") genre is a Sòng-Míng exegetical convention for prefatory matter that establishes the doctrinal-classificatory framework of a commentary in advance of the lemma-by-lemma exegesis itself. Preserved as **X12 no. 274** in the *Xùzàngjīng*.

**Abstract**

The *Xuánshì* is the **single most important programmatic statement** of Zhēnjiàn's late-Wànlì reform of *Lèngyán* exegesis: it explicitly rejects the dominant Tiāntái *huìjiě* tradition (descended from Tiānrú Wéizé [惟則](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%83%9F%E5%89%87)) on the grounds that it imposes the alien *sānguān* 三觀 framework on a sūtra whose own doctrinal architecture demands a different reading. Zhēnjiàn's alternative is what he calls "directly following the buddhasūtra" (奉順佛經), which in practice means a fresh sectional analysis and a re-reading focused on the sūtra's own *Tathāgatagarbharúláizàngxìng* doctrinal grammar. This polemical position became one of the defining flashpoints of late-Míng to early-Qing *Lèngyán* commentarial debate.

The dating bracket is set to **1576 – 1617**, corresponding to Zhēnjiàn's productive monastic career.
